page.home.description: 在浏览器标签页里用 Wake Lock API 让屏幕保持常亮。状态真实、预设时长、定时至某一时刻。无需账号。

page.home.intro: 只要此标签页可见，AwakeTab 就会使用浏览器的 Wake Lock API；只有浏览器确认锁定后，状态才会写屏幕已保持唤醒。
page.home.uses.title: What are you keeping awake?
page.home.uses.lead: Each one opens the tool already set for the job, with the length it needs.
page.home.uses.cooking.body: The recipe stays lit while your hands are floury, with kitchen timers beside it.
page.home.uses.reading.body: A long article stays on screen while you read, with no tap to wake it.
page.home.uses.presentations.body: Set it to the end of your talk and keep it in a floating window beside the slides.
page.home.uses.dashboards.body: A wall screen stays on all day, and a link can start the session as the page loads.
page.home.uses.videoCalls.body: The display stays on when the video pauses. Your chat status is left alone.
page.home.uses.downloads.body: The screen stays on through a long download, and a visible tab holds off idle sleep.
page.home.final.title: One tap, and the screen stays on.
page.home.final.body: The pill says {held} only after the browser confirms the lock. For a hidden tab or a minimised window, the extension keeps going.
page.home.final.docs: How it works, limits and FAQ in the docs
page.home.yours.title: Make it yours
page.home.yours.lead: Clock faces, colours, backgrounds, focus sounds and a notepad. Each one loads only when you pick it, and the status pill still tells you the truth.
page.home.yours.faces.title: Twelve clock faces
page.home.yours.faces.body: Classic, retro and modern. Every face shows your session, follows your lamp colour and knows when the screen is paused. Swipe the clock or press C to switch.
page.home.yours.looks.title: Themes, lamps and backgrounds
page.home.yours.looks.body: Clear Night, Paper and Nord, four lamps, three backgrounds and three presets are free. Pro adds six themes, eight lamps, a colour of your own, five backgrounds and five presets.
page.home.yours.looks.themes: Colour themes, each with a light and a dark version
page.home.yours.looks.tryNote: Any Pro look can be tried for 5 minutes, as often as you like. Nothing is saved.
page.home.yours.sound.title: Sounds for focus
page.home.yours.sound.body: Seven focus sounds made live in your browser, five end sounds, vibration and a quiet tick-tock, all free. Pro adds a mixer to layer them.
page.home.yours.sound.honest: Nothing plays until you ask, and sound never keeps the screen awake.
page.home.yours.notes.title: A notepad beside the clock
page.home.yours.notes.body: Checklists, headings, export and voice typing. Notes stay in this browser and work offline. One note is free; Pro keeps as many as you like.
page.home.yours.notes.sample.title: Before the call
page.home.yours.focus.title: Focus tools
page.home.yours.focus.body: A Pomodoro with pause and skip, an intention under the clock, a breathing guide and a second time zone. With Pro the Pomodoro repeats on its own.
page.home.ext.title: Keep the screen awake with the tab out of sight
page.home.ext.lead: The extension asks the browser itself to keep the screen awake, so it keeps going behind other windows.
page.home.ext.hidden.title: Tab hidden or window minimised
page.home.ext.hidden.body: It keeps going while the browser is running.
page.home.ext.system.title: Only the system, if you prefer
page.home.ext.system.body: System level keeps the computer awake and lets the screen dim or turn off.
page.home.ext.badge.title: Status in the toolbar
page.home.ext.badge.body: The badge shows ON, SYS or the minutes left.
page.home.ext.shortcut.title: A shortcut from any tab
page.home.ext.shortcut.body: {keys} starts or stops it without going back to the tab.
page.home.ext.note: Works in {browsers}, version {version} or later. {others} have no power API for extensions.
page.home.levels.title: Choose your level
page.home.levels.lead: Keeping a screen awake is free, in this tab and in the extension, and so are every clock face and focus sound. Pro adds more looks, a sound mixer, more notes and a longer memory.
page.home.levels.web.name: Web tab
page.home.levels.web.sub: Runs right here, in this tab.
page.home.levels.web.g1: Keeps the screen on while this tab is visible
page.home.levels.web.g2: 15 min to 4 h, until a time, or a custom length up to 7 days
page.home.levels.web.g3: Phones, tablets and computers, and offline after the first visit
page.home.levels.web.g4: A status pill that says awake only once the browser confirms it
page.home.levels.web.g5: Twelve clock faces, three colour themes, seven focus sounds, a notepad and a Pomodoro
page.home.levels.ext.name: Extension
page.home.levels.ext.g1: Keeps going with the tab hidden or the window minimised
page.home.levels.ext.g2: Screen or System: keep only the computer awake and let the screen sleep
page.home.levels.ext.g3: A toolbar badge with ON, SYS or the minutes left
page.home.levels.pro.name: Pro
page.home.levels.pro.g1: Your own message, up to 80 characters, on the awake screen
page.home.levels.pro.g2: Six more themes, eight more lamps, your own colour, five more backgrounds and five presets
page.home.levels.pro.g3: 12 weeks of history and a CSV export
page.home.levels.pro.g4: Schedules and auto-start in the extension
page.home.levels.pro.g5: A sound mixer, as many notes as you like and a Pomodoro that repeats
page.home.levels.pro.g6: Try the looks, the mixer, more notes and the repeating Pomodoro for 5 minutes first

page.pro.title: AwakeTab Pro plans and pricing — AwakeTab
page.pro.description: AwakeTab Pro adds colour themes, lamps, backgrounds, a sound mixer, more notes, a repeating Pomodoro, Message mode, 12 weeks of stats and extension schedules. Yearly or pay once, 5 devices, 14-day refund, no account.
page.pro.lead: Pro is optional. The awake screen stays honest and ad-free either way. Polar handles checkout; AwakeTab never stores a password.
page.pro.tax: Charged in USD; taxes added at checkout where applicable.
page.pro.refund: 14-day refund, no questions asked. Email support@awaketab.com with your receipt or use the Polar customer portal. Refunds deactivate the licence key.

page.pro.activate.description: Paste the licence key from your Polar receipt to activate AwakeTab Pro on this device. Checkout returns here automatically when Polar finishes.

page.pro.activate.ext: Copy this key and paste it in the AwakeTab for Chrome options page. There is no automatic hand-off.
page.pro.activate.ext.title: Your licence key
page.pro.activate.ext.lead: Enter your key here to copy it into AwakeTab for Chrome. This browser is not activated: the extension activates itself, so it uses one of your five activations, not two.
page.pro.manage.title: Manage Pro devices — AwakeTab
page.pro.manage.description: See which devices hold your AwakeTab Pro licence and remove one if you have reached the five-device limit.
page.pro.manage.lead: Devices unused for 90 days are removed automatically when you activate a new one.

page.pro.checkout.step1: Open the tool. Lamp colours, Message mode and 12 weeks of stats are ready in Settings.
page.pro.checkout.step2: Use Chrome too? Paste the same key into AwakeTab for Chrome’s settings. It counts as one more of your five.
page.pro.checkout.step3: Keep the email from Polar. It has your key, the receipt and a link to manage the plan.

page.pro.checkout.cancelled.aside.title: Before you decide
page.pro.checkout.cancelled.aside.launch: Pro is {yearly} / year, or {price} once at the launch price ({after} after; the end date is on the Pro page). Five devices, and a 14-day refund if it isn’t for you.
page.pro.checkout.cancelled.aside: Pro is {yearly} / year, or {price} once. Five devices, and a 14-day refund if it isn’t for you.
page.pro.checkout.failed.lead: Polar couldn’t take the payment, so nothing was charged and no licence was created.
page.pro.checkout.failed.l1: Check the card number, expiry date and billing postcode.
page.pro.checkout.failed.l2: Some banks hold the first payment to a new shop. Approving it in your bank’s app usually clears it.
page.pro.checkout.failed.l3: Try another card or payment method. Taxes are added at checkout, so the total can be above the list price.
page.pro.checkout.failed.aside.title: See a charge anyway?
page.pro.checkout.failed.aside.text: A declined payment can show as a pending hold for a few days, then drop off. If it doesn’t, email support@awaketab.com with the date and amount.
page.pro.checkout.help.lead: It is in the email from Polar, sent to the address you used at checkout, and on the receipt page.
page.pro.checkout.help.l1: Search your inbox for “Polar” and check spam or Promotions.
page.pro.checkout.help.l2: Just paid? Polar takes a few seconds to create the key. The activation page keeps checking for about 20 seconds on its own.
page.pro.checkout.help.l3: Keys and receipts are also in the Polar customer portal.
page.pro.checkout.help.l4: Still stuck? Email support@awaketab.com from the address you paid with.

page.pro.checkout.help.aside.title: If activation says this
page.pro.checkout.help.aside.text: Polar is still creating your key. Wait a minute and press Activate again; you are not charged twice.

page.pro.plans.after.value: Less than three years of the yearly plan.
page.pro.plans.shutdown: If AwakeTab ever shuts down, we will ship a final update that unlocks Pro for everyone.
page.pro.plans.tax: Charged in USD; taxes added at checkout where applicable. Both buttons open Polar checkout, and your licence key arrives by email and on the receipt page.
page.pro.refund.rest: Email support@awaketab.com with your receipt or use the Polar customer portal. Refunds deactivate the licence key.
page.pro.faq.q1: Does Pro keep the screen awake better?
page.pro.faq.a1: No. Free and Pro use the same wake lock and the same status pill. Pro adds looks, a sound mixer, more notes, a repeating Pomodoro, a message, history and schedules on top.
page.pro.faq.a2: No. Polar handles checkout and emails you a licence key. AwakeTab never stores a password.
page.pro.faq.a3: Each browser where you enter the key uses one of five activations. AwakeTab for Chrome activates itself and uses one too. Devices unused for 90 days are removed automatically when you activate a new one.

page.pro.biz.embed.text: Removes the "Keep awake by AwakeTab" credit. Licences open soon; the free embed works today.
page.pro.biz.kiosk.text: Signage and kiosk screens that stay awake from one URL, with your own logo and message.
page.pro.hero.title: Make AwakeTab yours
page.pro.hero.value: Keeping a screen awake is free and stays free, with every clock face and focus sound. Pro adds more themes, lamps and backgrounds, a sound mixer, more notes, a Pomodoro that repeats, Message mode, 12 weeks of stats, and schedules and auto-start in the Chrome extension.
page.pro.hero.price.launch: {yearly} a year, or {once} once at the launch price.
page.pro.cmp.h2: Free or Pro, side by side
page.pro.cmp.lead: Everything that keeps a screen awake is free, in the web tab and in the extension. Pro uses the same wake lock and the same honest status pill, and adds the extras in the Pro column.
page.pro.cmp.caption: What the free web tab, the free extension and Pro include
page.pro.cmp.r.awake: Keeps the screen awake, with an honest status pill
page.pro.cmp.r.lengths: Every length, from 15 min to 7 days, until a time or until you stop
page.pro.cmp.r.faces: Twelve clock faces and seven ambient modes, Cook timers and Breathe included
page.pro.cmp.r.themes: Colour themes, each with a light and a dark version
page.pro.cmp.v.patterns.pro: Adds Contours, Waves, Aurora, Stars, Drift
page.pro.cmp.r.preview: Try a Pro look, the mixer, more notes or the repeating Pomodoro for 5 minutes
page.pro.cmp.r.sounds: Seven focus sounds, five end sounds, vibration, tick-tock and media keys
page.pro.cmp.v.library.pro: Recorded tracks as we add them
page.pro.cmp.r.notes: Notepad with checklists, export and voice typing
page.pro.cmp.r.tools: An intention, a breathing guide and a second time zone
page.pro.cmp.r.ext: Screen or System level, timers and the toolbar badge
page.pro.cmp.r.auto: Auto-start when Chrome opens or on a site you pick
page.pro.get.lead: On up to five devices. Pro changes what AwakeTab looks like and remembers, never how the screen is kept awake.
page.pro.get.msg.p: Your own line, up to 80 characters, in big type on the awake screen. Anyone who opens a shared Message link can try it free for 5 minutes.
page.pro.get.stats.p: Free stats show the last 7 days. Pro keeps 12 weeks and exports your sessions as a CSV file.
page.pro.get.pip.p: The floating window that stays on top of your other apps opens a third taller.
page.pro.get.sched.p: In AwakeTab for Chrome, pick the days and hours a screen stays on, or start when Chrome opens or when you visit a site you choose.
page.pro.get.ads.p: Guide pages may carry ads to pay for the free tool. With Pro they don't. The awake screen has no ads for anyone.
page.pro.get.looks.p: Six more colour themes, from Solarized to High contrast, eight more lamps and a colour of your own, five more backgrounds such as Aurora and Stars, and presets like Night desk. Clear Night, Paper, Nord and four lamps stay free.
page.pro.get.sound.p: Layer rain, café, fire and noise, each at its own level. A lo-fi library will hold recorded tracks as we add them. The seven focus sounds, one at a time, stay free.
page.pro.get.notes.h: As many notes as you like
page.pro.get.notes.p: Titles, search and pins for every note you keep. Notes stay in your browser and are never uploaded. One note is free.
page.pro.get.pomo.p: After the long break, focus blocks start again on their own until you stop, and every finished block counts in your stats. Pause and skip are free.
page.pro.plans.lead.all: Both plans include everything above on 5 devices. There is no monthly plan and no account.
page.pro.plans.cancel: Cancel any time. Pro stays on until the end of the year you paid for.
page.pro.how.lead: No account to create. A licence key does the work, and Polar sends it to you.
page.pro.how.s1.p: The plan button opens Polar checkout. Polar takes the payment, adds any tax and emails your receipt with the licence key.
page.pro.how.s2.p: Polar brings you back to AwakeTab, and this browser activates itself. If it can't, paste the key from the email.
page.pro.how.s3.p: Enter the same key in up to five browsers in total. AwakeTab for Chrome takes it in its settings and counts as one of them.
page.pro.how.s4.p: See where Pro is on and remove a device to free its place. Devices unused for 90 days are removed automatically when you activate a new one.
page.pro.trust.polar.p: Polar is the seller of record: it takes the card, charges tax where it applies and sends the receipt. AwakeTab never sees your card.
page.pro.trust.cancel.p: The yearly plan renews through Polar. Cancel in the Polar customer portal, and Pro stays on until the end of the year you paid for.
page.pro.trust.privacy.p: Your licence is a key, plus a random ID and a label such as “Chrome · macOS” for each device. Polar keeps your email for the receipt.
page.pro.faq.q5: Can I try Pro before paying?
page.pro.faq.a5: Yes. In the tool, every Pro theme, lamp, background and preset, the sound mixer, more notes, the repeating Pomodoro and a shared Message link can be tried for 5 minutes, as often as you like. A small bar counts down, then the tool goes back to your free choice, and nothing is saved. After you pay, the 14-day refund still applies.
page.pro.faq.q6: What happens if my yearly plan ends?
page.pro.faq.a6: Pro features switch off and the free tool keeps working. Your settings stay, and stats older than 7 days are hidden, not deleted. Renew and they come back.
page.pro.faq.a7: No. Pro is {yearly} a year, or one payment with no renewal. Both cover 5 devices.
page.pro.end.h2: Add Pro to the tab you already use
page.pro.end.lead: {once} once or {yearly} a year, on 5 devices, with a 14-day refund.

ext.about.title: 关于
page.extension.title: 让屏幕保持常亮的 Chrome 扩展 — AwakeTab
page.extension.description: AwakeTab for Chrome 可从工具栏让屏幕或电脑保持唤醒，即使标签页被隐藏也有效。支持计时器和计划，状态诚实，不做追踪。
page.extension.lead: 网页版只有在标签页可见时才能保持唤醒锁。扩展会直接请求 Chrome 让屏幕（或仅让电脑）保持唤醒，因此即使标签页被隐藏或窗口已最小化也能继续工作。

page.extension.features.levels: 屏幕或系统：让屏幕保持常亮，或者只让电脑保持唤醒、屏幕可以变暗。
page.extension.features.timers: 与网页版相同的预设：15 分钟到 4 小时、到指定时间，或直到你停止。
page.extension.features.badge: 工具栏徽标会显示 ON、SYS 或剩余分钟数，在任意标签页按 Alt+Shift+A 即可开关。
page.extension.features.pro: Pro 版：每周计划，以及在 Chrome 启动或访问你选定的网站时自动启动。
page.extension.limits.running: 只在 Chrome 运行时有效。
page.extension.limits.lid: 合上笔记本盖子时无法阻止睡眠。

page.extension.fact.private: No ads, no site access by default
page.extension.alt.why: Why there is no extension for this browser
page.extension.compare.title: Tab or extension
page.extension.steps.title: Ready in three steps
page.extension.steps.install.title: Install
page.extension.steps.install.body: Add it from the Chrome Web Store, or from Edge Add-ons in Edge.
page.extension.steps.pin.title: Pin it
page.extension.steps.pin.body: Open the Extensions menu (the puzzle piece) and pin AwakeTab, so its badge stays in view.
page.extension.steps.press.title: Press the shortcut
page.extension.steps.press.body: From any tab, it starts your usual length. Press it again to stop. On a Mac, Alt is the Option key.
page.extension.permissions.lead: Three it needs to work, two you can turn on. It gets no site access unless you pick a site.
page.extension.faq.title: Questions
page.extension.faq.a1: Yes. Timers, Screen or System, the toolbar badge and the shortcut are free. Pro adds weekly schedules and auto-start.
page.extension.faq.q2: Can it see the sites I visit?
page.extension.faq.a2: No. It has no site access by default and never sends URLs, tab titles or site names. Auto-start on a site, a Pro feature, asks for access to that one site.
page.extension.faq.q3: Why not just use the web app?
page.extension.faq.a3: The web app keeps the screen awake only while its tab is visible. The extension keeps going while you work in other tabs or with the window minimised, as long as Chrome is running.
page.extension.faq.a4: Yes. Open chrome://extensions/shortcuts in Chrome, or edge://extensions/shortcuts in Edge, and set your own. Do that too if another extension already uses Alt+Shift+A.
page.extension.faq.q5: Does the extension have the clock faces, sounds and notes?
page.extension.faq.a5: No, those live in the web app. The extension keeps the screen, or only the computer, awake from the toolbar. Open AwakeTab from its pop-up for the twelve clock faces, colour themes, focus sounds, the notepad and the focus tools.
